Name: SimpleSoundManager
Author: Omegasis
Description:
Lets SMAPI mods use custom wave/sound banks. This allows for things like playing music/sounds at a time of day, when an object is interacted with, etc.
Note that this mod is mainly intended for mod authors to add additional sound support for their mods. By itself, this mod doesn't do anything.

[b][color=#6aa84f]Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.4+ on Linux, Mac, and Windows. Requires SMAPI 3.0 or later.[/color][/b]

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=5]Usage[/size][list=1]
[*]Download this mod and reference it when making your mod.
[*]Create new wave/sound banks using XACT.
[*]Create a new SoundManager in your mod.
[*]Play sounds to your heart's content.
[/list]
[size=5]Here is a tutorial video for how to use this mod![/size]
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uRWUOYEbTJQ][size=4]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uRWUOYEbTJQ[/size][/url]
